answer: Proof-of-burn mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy scarce native tokens to register identities. An attacker incurs an unrecoverable capital expenditure per identity, establishing an economic anchor as durable as basalt. Nodes publish a cryptographic beacon of these burn proofs, stopping identity spam before manipulation can ripple through the market. A core limitation is that burning capital prices out legitimate, resource-constrained agents.
